nodes.label: Next.js Storefront
nodes.rationale: Next.js on Vercel chosen for SSR performance, instant-load times, and seamless Vercel hosting. Provides editorial animations and minimalist UI capabilities.

nodes.label: Supabase Data Layer
nodes.rationale: Supabase selected as single source of truth to eliminate dual-backend complexity. Provides Auth, PostgREST, RLS, and Edge Functions in one managed service.

nodes.label: Saleor Legacy Backend (Deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Saleor/Django was the original e-commerce engine providing GraphQL API for products and orders. Being decommissioned in favor of Supabase to simplify architecture and eliminate Docker dependency.

nodes.label: Saleor to Supabase Migration
nodes.rationale: Migration eliminates Docker dependency, simplifies dev setup to npm run dev + npx supabase start, and unifies data layer. Removes Apollo Client/GraphQL in favor of Supabase JS SDK.

nodes.label: OTP Verification (COD Checkout)
nodes.rationale: OTP via SMS/WhatsApp required before COD order is confirmed to mitigate fake orders. Currently mocked in dev terminal.

nodes.label: Dual-Write Order Logic (Saleor + Supabase)
nodes.rationale: Orders written to both Saleor (inventory deduction, e-commerce engine) and Supabase (custom business logic, bespoke measurements). Saleor acts as strict gatekeeper - if Saleor fails, Supabase is not written.

nodes.label: Centralized Pricing Management (Admin)
nodes.rationale: Single admin page to sync price changes to both Saleor and Supabase simultaneously, ensuring data consistency across both systems.

nodes.label: Supabase Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: RLS enforced so public users only see is_active=true products; admin writes require authenticated role. Security enforced at database level.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Saleor Stack
nodes.rationale: Docker Compose used to orchestrate Saleor API, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery worker, and Mailpit for local dev. Being decommissioned after migration.

nodes.label: Apollo Client / GraphQL (Deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Legacy data fetching via Apollo Client -> Saleor GraphQL. Being replaced by Supabase JS SDK to align with serverless architecture.
